title: category
description: Morphisms closed under an associative composition that has an identity on every object — the structure arrows assemble into. The objects are not primitive: they are recovered from the morphisms (an object is its hom-set, Yoneda). The corpus's canonical instance is the predicate-category, a Lawvere hyperdoctrine whose fibers are the bilattice FOUR.

morphisms.description: the arrows; a collection Hom(A, B) for every ordered pair of objects

identities.description: an identity morphism id_A for every object

associativity.description: composition is associative and unital — the two and only laws
